name: Darksing D-45
description: The Darksing D-45 was a heavy freighter owned by the Nallera's mining crew in the Tatoo system during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, the ship was captured by the Zynt'aia pirates but it was eventually recaptured by the starfighter forces dispatched by Mining Chief Operator A'Lerris Verata.
